candidates.name: Fresh artifact handoff
candidates.mechanism: Review in a new context using explicit artifact and source inputs.
candidates.limitations: Host context and shared filesystem still need isolation checks.

candidates.name: Native trace proof
candidates.mechanism: Validate real reviewer dispatch, successful reads and completion.
candidates.why_it_matters: Prevents a model receipt from masquerading as executed review.
candidates.limitations: Native traces may be unavailable on cloud surfaces.

candidates.name: Second simplicity pass
candidates.mechanism: Review architecture again after critique adds mitigations.
candidates.why_it_matters: Catches complexity introduced by the review process itself.
candidates.limitations: Adds latency and has unmeasured marginal benefit.

candidates.name: Contract and drift checking
candidates.mechanism: Generate bounded component contracts and compare them with current source.
candidates.limitations: Agent judgments need checking and do not prove equivalence.
